title: Common YouTube watch URLs are rejected when v is not the first query parameter
reasoning: The watch URL regex only matches URLs whose query string begins exactly with ?v=. Valid and commonly shared YouTube URLs such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=abc&v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or URLs with other parameters before v fail extract_video_id and are returned as invalid, so the media pipeline will skip transcript extraction for them.
recommendation: Parse URLs with urllib.parse instead of regex for watch URLs: verify the host, path, and query parameter v. Keep regex only for path-based formats like youtu.be, shorts, embed, and live or parse those paths structurally as well.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The URL tests only cover a watch URL where v is the first query parameter, short links, and invalid non-YouTube URLs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests for watch URLs with v after other query parameters and with additional parameters after v.
minimumFixScope: app/services/youtube_service.py URL parsing and tests/test_youtube_service.py coverage.
